about: Recitations the iOS check plays to the real speech engine in the simulator (step 'Voice proof' of .github/workflows/ios-check.yml, docs/voice-test-clips.md). Nothing here is committed audio: each clip is fetched at run time from its own source and checked against its size and SHA-256. A clip's name says what it holds: <id>__<surah>-<first verse>-<last verse>.wav.
